context_requirements: Cells must take up and phosphorylate the nucleoside analog to the active triphosphate.
Mitochondrial DNA polymerase gamma must be engaged for mitochondrial toxicity.
Cells must have intact p53 or related stress-response pathways for transcriptional cell-cycle arrest.
Hepatocyte-like metabolic capacity may enhance PXR/lipid effects for some NRTIs.
falsifiers: No change in any of the listed late_up or late_down genes at 24 h in any of the nine lines.
A clear increase in proliferation markers such as MKI67, PCNA, or TOP2A at 24 h.
A strong interferon signature at 6 h or 24 h.
A strong unfolded protein response or heat-shock signature at 6 h.
No line shows any transcriptional response at 10 micromolar.

evidence.supports: NRTI ddC induces oxidative stress in mitochondria and synaptosomes within 6 h.
NNRTI efavirenz reduces neural stem cell proliferation and mitochondrial membrane potential.
NNRTI efavirenz causes mitochondrial membrane depolarization and apoptosis in hepatoma cells.
NNRTI efavirenz activates PXR and alters lipid/cholesterol gene expression.
